name: c5_endeavor_substitute
purpose: C5 Endeavor (decision 0015 entry 5cy): Quaquaval (slot a, Close Combat on turn 1 takes it to about 43 to 61 HP) and Milotic (slot b, 202 HP, Substitute on turn 1: its HP falls to 152) on both sides. Turn 2 Quaquaval's Endeavor on Milotic: not immune (the user's HP is below 152), the damage (152 minus user HP) is capped at the Substitute's 50 and breaks it (moves.ts:18341-18369). Team V3 (Milotic leads), mirror.
